title: SOUND AND HEARING
description: Introductory acoustics, basics of waves and discrete mechanical systems. The mechanics of hearing - how sound is transmitted through the external and middle ear to the inner ear, and the mechanical processing of sound within the inner ear.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( PHYS UN1401 ) and ( MATH UN1201 )
